title: Social News Feed
vague_prompt: Design the news feed for a social product.
hidden_guidance: 50 million DAU, and each user follows 200 accounts on average
Read to write ratio about 100 to 1
The first feed page must load in under 200 ms at p95
A new post can appear in follower feeds after a few seconds, so strict ordering is not required
The feed keeps the newest 1000 posts for each user
Every post can carry images and short video
known_patterns: Fanout on write for normal users and fanout on read for accounts with more than 100k followers
Per user feed cache that holds a list of post IDs
Ranking service between the cache and the client
Post store keyed by author with a time ordered index
Async fanout through a work queue
common_misses: Celebrity fanout to millions of followers
Feed cache memory sizing and eviction
Deduplication and backfill after a fanout lag
Delete and edit propagation into cached feeds
